count.description: Number of dumps to write before exiting.

poll_interval.description: Consecutive seconds before dump is written (default is 10).

cpu_threshold.description: CPU threshold above which to create a dump of the process.

cpu_relative_single_core.description: Treat CPU usage relative to a single core (used with -c).

memory_threshold.description: Memory commit threshold in MB at which to create a dump.

dump_type.description: Dump file type: mini, full, triage, or miniplus.

log_traces.description: Writes extended ProcDump tracing to syslog.

wait_for_process.description: Wait for the specified process to launch if it's not running.

filters.description: Comma-separated exception name/message filters (include). Supports wildcards.

exception_handling.description: Write a dump when the process encounters an unhandled exception.

dump_target.description: Target process name, service name, or PID to monitor.

dump_path.description: Dump file name or folder path.
